3 min read · April 30, 2025
April 30, 2025
Share
Stay at the forefront of cutting-edge research with EHA’s open access, peer-reviewed journal.
With a preliminary 2025 Impact Factor of 11.3, placing it #8 in indexed hematology journals worldwide, HemaSphere is an invaluable resource for hematologists at every career stage.
Our continuous online publications support the global hematology community by sharing:
Results of high-impact basic, translational, and clinical hematology research
Insightful review articles
Clinical practice guidelines
Reports of new therapies
Recommendations for future research and clinical applications
Discussions on European policy
And more
We also provide the hematology community with a friction-free route to publishing and publication access through our:
Fast and constructive review process
100% open access content
Low publication fees
Latest issue
Explore this month’s HemaSphere issue, featuring a broad range of hematology papers and insightful discussions on trending topics.
HemaSphere podcast
Listen to the latest HemaSphere podcast and enjoy lighthearted conversations about the research stories behind the publications.
This audio companion to our official journal is available on a range of podcast platforms, and we launch new episodes regularly.
Call for novel findings
HemaSphere is interested in high-impact studies that share novel findings.
If your study fits this description, please feel free to submit it online for our consideration. HemaSphere does not charge any submission fees.
